tagline: Their own canopied spot on the patio, right beside your garden chair.
lead: Your dog gets a raised, cushioned place of their own in the garden, right beside where you sit.
value: The raised platform, woven shell, canopy and cushion come together in one day bed, and the cushion is included.
intro: Cove is an outdoor dog day bed: a raised platform with an open-sided woven shell, a canopy and a cushion included. Ask us for exact measurements before ordering.
points: The raised day-bed shape gives them a defined spot to settle.
A softer surface to lie on comes with the bed.
Keeps the structure visually light on the patio or in the garden.
Place it in safe shade with drinking water nearby; a canopy can't stop a dog overheating.
best_for: Supervised lounging on the patio or in the garden in suitable weather. Bring them indoors in extreme weather; it isn't all-weather housing.
fit_note: Ask us for exact dimensions before ordering, and check the resting area, entrance height and supported load. Your dog should be able to get in, stand, turn and lie down comfortably.
care: Wipe the shell with a damp cloth and mild soap. Follow the cushion's own care label and store it under cover. Let all parts dry before use.
